svg.text: Project cards · Agent cards · Dependency graph · Unified Chat co-pilot · Kill / Repair / Restart controls
Progressive refinement: attempt 1 clean · attempt 2 +last_failure · attempt 3+ +git_diff · post-research +diagnosis
Exhaustion: bug/feature/refactor → research feeder spawned (original task stays, no reparenting) · qa/plan → cancel
Agent Runtime · swarm/agent_runtime.py · (up to N parallel subprocesses)
main(): call_llm() → parse [TOOL_CALL] → execute_tool() → repeat · max 200 loops · stall detection (3× identical → redirect)
Tool dispatch: swarm/tool_dispatch.py · permission_profile enforced before tool executes · plugin tools_blocked always wins
Tools: read_file · write_file · patch_file · git_commit · git_push · run_command · create_task · web_search · broadcast_write · delegate_helper
Vision tools (QA): launch_game · vision_query · click_element · get_game_state (TCP 11009) · press_button · a11y_tree
Prompts: plugin prompt (if registered) → built-in YAML (feature/bug/polish/qa/harness_qa/scenario_qa/research/plan/project_plan/art_pass/audit...)
Context compaction at ~120k tokens · token counts → data/agent_<task_id>_tokens.json · git worktree isolation per agent
Pre-flight baseline: capture existing errors before agent runs
Post-agent diff: only NEW errors count as failures
Godot: --headless check_scripts.gd · GUT tests if addons/gut/ present
Python: py_compile · pytest · Swift: swiftc · Rust: cargo check
Failure → priority-100 bug task (dependents reparented to bug task)
Exhausted bug/feature/refactor: research feeder spawned · original task reset to pending (blocked on feeder)
Feeder completes: findings injected into original · dep removed · original retries with diagnosis
Feeder exhausts: needs_human_review flag set · run_after +24h snooze · red border in dashboard
Agent loop limit: 200 tool calls · Wall-clock watchdog: 7200s · Max agents: configurable (default 3, auto-scales up to ceiling) · Stall detection: 3× identical tool call → redirect prompt
Context compaction: at ~120k estimated tokens (middle of conversation summarised, system + 4-message tail preserved)
Auto-QA: every 8 Godot completions · Auto-audit: every 20 completions · QA cycle cap: configurable (default 3 requeues)
Task priorities: 100 = critical/bug · 85 = research feeder · 80 = bug · 75 = QA · 50 = feature/polish
Escalation policy: bug/feature/refactor exhausted → research feeder (original stays in graph) · qa/plan/research exhausted → cancel
Validation: pre-flight baseline captured before agent runs; only NEW errors introduced by agent trigger failure (inherited errors skipped)
Built-in: feature · bug · refactor · polish · qa · harness_qa · hybrid_qa · scenario_qa · art_pass · audit · research · plan · project_plan · triage
Plugin-defined: any task_type declared in plugins/*.yaml — custom prompt, permission profile, context providers, tool allowlist/blocklist
